chunks: With this chain of transmission, from al-Fuḍayl ibn Yasār, al-Faḍl ibn ʿAbd al-Malik, and Bukayr, who said: We heard Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام saying:

The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم used to perform, in supererogatory prayer, twice the amount of the obligatory prayer, and he used to fast, in supererogatory fasting, twice the amount of the obligatory fasting.

key_terms.الْفَرِيضَةِ: the obligatory duty prescribed by Allah
key_terms.رَسُولُ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم

ai.seo_question: How much supererogatory salat (prayer) and fasting did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم perform?
ai.summary: This hadith reports the practice of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم in performing abundant supererogatory acts of worship. It highlights that his voluntary salat (prayer) and sawm (fasting) were in an amount double the obligatory duties, showing the great importance of nawafil in worship.
